hypothesis: A baseline-anchored output-decoder refinement on source-registered OS incident abstractions can improve cumulative resource forecasts without materially regressing the frozen base distribution. Independently specified protected-asset, critical-service, and absolute process-occupancy predicates should close semantic and temporal gaps that transition training alone cannot repair.

candidate.fit_method: Equal-domain weighted ridge regression anchored to the runtime-v2 output decoder.
candidate.selection_metric: incident validation geometric H1/H3/H5 normalized error, then base validation geometric H1/H3/H5 normalized error

fixed_policy_repairs.reason: These rules address target semantics, shared service authority, and cumulative occupancy that the current state-transition model does not represent reliably. They are frozen before validation selection and are reported separately from learned gains.

simulator_labels.hud_update_provenance: Known post-publication failure cluster from the already public study fixture; legacy-fixture improvement is therefore a regression result, not fresh generalization evidence.
simulator_labels.boundary: These labels are engineered abstractions and must not be described as measurements from the cited incidents.

selection_gates: no base-validation H1, H3, or H5 normalized error regresses by more than two percent
base-validation H1/H3/H5 geometric error does not regress
incident-validation H1/H3/H5 geometric error improves by at least five percent with no individual-horizon regression
incident-validation learned-only false negatives do not increase
incident-validation rules-plus-candidate false negatives do not increase under the same fixed v3 policy
incident-validation false-positive rate under the fixed v3 policy increases by no more than two percentage points
the prediction-delta variance ratio remains at least 0.10
the final source catalog is neither opened nor generated into scenarios during selection
the deployed encoder, transition artifact, and manifest remain byte-identical
selection_rule: Choose the accepted candidate with the lowest incident validation geometric H1/H3/H5 ratio, breaking ties by base validation geometric ratio. If no candidate passes, retain runtime v2 and do not open the final catalog.

final_test.opening_policy: Generate and evaluate exactly once after a successful validation-only selection.

final_promotion_gates: final source-held-out H1/H3/H5 geometric error improves by at least five percent with no individual-horizon regression
final rules-plus-candidate false negatives decrease and false-positive rate increases by no more than two percentage points versus runtime v2 under the same scenarios
the fixed v3 policy plus selected candidate exceeds the published 0.814 balanced accuracy and the runtime-v2 0.818 balanced accuracy on the frozen legacy fixture
legacy fixture false negatives are fewer than 50 and false positives are no greater than 41
published-corpus untouched-test H1/H3/H5 metrics remain within the registered two-percent per-metric tolerance and improve geometrically
Brier score does not regress on the final incident benchmark; ECE is reported without claiming separation unless its interval excludes zero
the FWM2 artifact loads in the no_std runtime and world-model authority-boundary tests pass
promotion is atomic and updates the manifest only after all prior gates pass
negative_result_policy: Every failed grid candidate and gate result remains in the selection report. A failed selection or final test is evidence, not permission to retune on the final catalog.
authority: The learned branch may only add caution. It cannot grant capabilities, bypass deterministic predicates, satisfy Tier 3/4 confirmation, execute a tool, or authorize a kernel update.
claim_boundary: The source-derived benchmark is deterministic software simulation, not replay of production incidents.
Source-held-out means the final reports were excluded from fitting and selection; it does not mean unseen action types or independent assessment.
The published paper and dataset remain immutable versioned artifacts regardless of this study outcome.
A passing local runtime gate is emulator evidence, not production deployment, physical hardware, certification, or a safety guarantee.
